params.caption: Shu gapni ko'p eshitamiz: I am interesting in English. Niyat yaxshi, lekin aslida bu "men qiziqarli odamman" degandek chiqib qoladi 🙂 To'g'risi: I'm interested in English, ya'ni "ingliz tiliga qiziqaman". Farqi oddiy. -ed bilan odam nimani his qilayotganini aytamiz, -ing bilan esa o'sha hisni nima uyg'otayotganini. The film was boring, so I was bored. Kino zerikarli edi, shuning uchun zerikdim. I'm always tired after a tiring day. We were surprised, the results were really surprising. Kichik maslahat: o'z his-tuyg'uingiz haqida gapirayotgan bo'lsangiz, deyarli har doim -ed kerak. Darsda "I'm boring" desangiz, "zerikdim" emas, "men zerikarli odamman" degan bo'lasiz, o'qituvchi kulib yuborishi mumkin.
